name: ledger-pustaka-itb
description: Prototipe riwayat peminjaman buku Perpustakaan ITB di atas blockchain lokal (tugas besar Infrastruktur Blockchain)

scripts.postinstall: npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix frontend
scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n chain,api,web -c cyan,yellow,magenta "npm run chain" "wait-on tcp:127.0.0.1:8545 && npm run deploy && npm run seed && npm run api" "wait-on http-get://127.0.0.1:4000/health && npm run web"
